rationale: Development: seeds modestly reduce expansions; strict admissible-bound detour filter limits quality regression; lazy ranked validation preserves eager outputs. Potentials are quality-only candidates. Runtime benefit not established; geometric seeds competitive. All validation results will be reported, not just favorable subsets.
validation: 20 established validation maps, all standard/cot/repe caches, 600 observations, 9 randomized repeats. This historical validation split was used by prior sessions; no Session3 tuning after this freeze.
fresh: 30 new procedural maps,10 families,3 maps each,2 queries,4 deterministic fixture qualities,240 cases,7 repeats; seed990000 and anisotropic integer scales prevent reuse of prior geometry. Helpful fixtures are oracle-derived, NOT real LLM output.
primary_claim_rule: No LLM-specific benefit unless matched disabled and geometric/random controls support it. Cost and runtime tradeoffs reported. CIs exploratory/unadjusted across multiple secondary comparisons.
